hero.description: Transform 2D blueprints and multi-page PDFs into interactive models with automatic room detection, millimeter-accurate AI area calculations, and team collaboration by levels and projects.

showcase.title: Experience the Power of Every Module
showcase.subtitle: See how FloorPlan Management System automates the most complex workflows for architects, civil engineers, and real estate developers.

upload.title: Upload & Calibration
upload.description: Upload multi-page PDF documents or high-resolution images. The platform automatically detects blueprint orientation, visual scale, and lets you select specific pages to process.
points: Native multi-page PDF support with high-performance preview.
Intelligent orientation detection and automatic leveling.
Interactive cropping tools to isolate rooms or apartment units.

editor.title: Interactive Editor
editor.description: A responsive canvas equipped with metric/imperial ruler calibration, ultra-smooth viewport pan/zoom, specialty layers, and room visibility toggles.
points: Interactive ruler for exact scale calibration.
Multi-layer support for architecture, structure, and MEP.
Smooth zooming with high-resolution gigapixel blueprint support.

areas.title: Area & Polygon Management
areas.description: Draw, adjust, and tag polygon boundaries with sub-pixel precision. Instantly compute square meters, perimeters, and categorize by space destination.
points: Dynamic polygon drawing with vertex dragging and editing.
Instant calculation of floor surface ($m^2$) and perimeter.
Color-coded categories by specialty and space classification.

ai.title: AI Inference (YOLO Vision)
ai.description: Our state-of-the-art YOLO computer vision neural networks automatically detect rooms, walls, doors, and windows in seconds with real-time feedback.
points: Automated deep learning detection of spaces and boundaries.
Instantly generated polygon meshes ready for export or editing.

features.title: Everything You Need for Blueprint Management
features.subtitle: Engineered for architecture firms, construction contractors, and asset managers.

items.title: Advanced Computer Vision
items.desc: Trained neural models that understand architectural plans, reading room boundaries, symbols, and spatial layouts automatically.

items.title: Organizations & Role Management
items.desc: Structure projects by companies and teams. Manage permissions with token invitations and granular role controls.

items.title: Multi-Level & Tower Hierarchy
items.desc: Organize blueprints across floors, levels, and elevation ranges for residential and commercial developments.

items.title: Floor Plan Normalization
items.desc: Automatic scale and orientation detection aligns every uploaded plan to a common metric reference before analysis begins.

items.title: Data Export & Reports
items.desc: Generate detailed area schedules, export layered blueprints, and collaborate smoothly with your team.

workflow.title: From 2D Blueprint to Smart Model in 3 Steps
workflow.step1Desc: Drag and drop your PDF plans or CAD scans. The system parses pages and detects scales automatically.
workflow.step2Desc: Our computer vision engine recognizes rooms, spaces, and computes surface areas within seconds.
workflow.step3Desc: Fine-tune polygons, assign specialties, and share with your team or clients with full version control.

pipelineFigure.title: What the engine actually does to a plan
pipelineFigure.subtitle: Sixteen passes over three scans of the same house. The structural frame comes back first, then the walls and openings, then the electrical installation — and the three partial models are federated into a single IFC file. Press play, or step through one pass at a time.
pipelineFigure.frameTitle: Animated walkthrough: from three scanned plans to one federated IFC model
pipelineFigure.note: Drawing redrawn from the Guernica case study, Buenos Aires. Structural and architectural detection follow Urbieta et al., Journal of Building Engineering 78 (2023) 107672; the MEP extension is current research at LIFIA.
